Hines has expanded its Italian logistics portfolio through two investments totaling approximately 213,000 square meters (2.3 million square feet) on behalf of its Hines European Core Fund (HECF) and Hines European Real Estate Partners III (HEREP III).

The global real assets investment manager acquired a 19,000-square-meter (204,500-square-foot) logistics complex in San Giuliano Milanese, near Milan, for HECF. Separately, the firm conditionally committed to the forward purchase of a 194,000-square-meter (2.1 million-square-foot) class A logistics park in Pozzolo Formigaro, northern Italy, for HEREP III.

The investments reflect Hines’ strategy of deploying capital across core and value-add opportunities in Italy’s logistics sector.
